lede: Wat Ratchakhrue accounts for 3 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Phayao (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (67%) over khoi paper · กระดาษข่อย (33%). Dated witnesses run 1928–1928 CE (1 of 3 carry a date).
